title: 一天的生活

explanations.1: The story introduces a male subject; 'he' is the natural pronoun.
explanations.2: The particle '了' indicates the action 'get up' is completed.
explanations.3: The numeral 'one' is needed before the measure word 'cup'.
explanations.4: The measure word 'cup' pairs with the noun 'milk'.
explanations.5: The measure word 'piece' is used with the noun 'bread'.
explanations.6: The verb 'go' indicates the direction to the company.
explanations.7: The preposition 'at' shows the location of the company.
explanations.9: The conjunction 'and/with' links the subject and his colleagues.
explanations.10: The adverb 'together' indicates joint action of eating.
explanations.11: The position noun 'inside' indicates entering the home.
explanations.12: The noun 'meal' is the object of the verb 'eat'.
explanations.13: The verb 'watch' goes with the noun 'TV'.
explanations.14: The frequency adverb 'often' modifies the studying habit.
explanations.15: The noun 'sleep' serves as the object in the verb phrase 'sleep (the) sleep'.

translation: He got up at seven in the morning. He first washed his face and brushed his teeth. Then he drank a glass of milk and ate a piece of bread. Next he took the subway to go to the company. The company was in front of his home. At noon he had lunch with his colleagues. In the afternoon he continued working. In the evening he returned home to cook. He made a dish. Then he ate while watching TV. After that he read books and studied Chinese. He often studied in the evening. He went to bed at half past ten.
